signal: VitalEdge appointed Shane Martin CRO in Jan 2026, after acquiring Integrated Rental and launching VitalityAI for heavy-equipment dealers

email.body1:
Shane, saw you stepped into the CRO seat at VitalEdge right as the team launched VitalityAI and folded in Integrated Rental.

A new CRO inheriting an expanded product usually finds more dealer accounts in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VitalEdge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Shane, quick follow-up for VitalEdge.

A new CRO usually inherits a number set before the coverage plan exists. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings VitalEdge needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Shane, last bit of proof for VitalEdge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VitalEdge's reply rate likely compares to other dealer software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Shane, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority in your first quarters as CRO, no problem at all. A new seat plus a product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dealer-sales motion? I will tailor it to VitalEdge either way.
